candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assignment to msg.sender (so transferOwnership sets owner to caller instead of _newOwner).
Remove the require check from onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call guarded functions and thus permitting transferOwnership to set owner to _newOwner when called by non-owner.
Insert a require that prevents setting owner to the provided _newOwner if it is the zero address, causing some transferOwnership calls to revert and thus leave owner unchanged.
Replace empty body of owned() with assignment setting owner to caller, changing owner after call to owned().
Replace onlyOwner modifier's require check with no-op (remove require), allowing anyone to call owned() and thus potentially change owner when owned() is modified or other functions use the modifier.
Invert onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, making owner-only guarded functions callable by non-owners which could change owner through owned() if it modifies state.
Replace assignment to owner with a no-op (remove state update) so transferOwnership no longer changes owner.
Change assignment to set owner to tx.origin instead of the provided _newOwner, causing a different owner after call.
Remove the require guard so anyone can call transferOwnership, changing owner when called by non-owner addresses.
